data.form_title: General consent for admission and treatment
data.form_body:
I agree to be admitted to this hospital and to receive the examinations, tests, nursing care and treatment my doctors consider necessary. An operation, anaesthesia, a blood transfusion or another risky procedure will be explained to me separately and done only with my separate consent.
The need for my admission and the expected length and cost of my stay, written below, were explained to me. I understand that they are estimates that may change with my condition, and that I will be told when they change.
I will follow the rules of the hospital: visiting hours, attendants, no smoking, and the safety of its property and staff.
I will tell the doctors and nurses the truth about my illness, my medicines, my allergies and my earlier treatment.
I allow the hospital to share information about my illness with the health authorities where the law requires it (for example notifiable diseases, births and deaths). Otherwise my information stays confidential.
I may ask questions at any time, and I may refuse or stop a treatment after I am told what that may mean.
